title: WipEout Omega Collection (wipeout_pc)
description: WipEout Omega Collection (PS4) native PC port for Windows and Linux: the game's own x86-64 code on the CPU, a PS4 runtime and the shadPS4 Vulkan video core. Playable, in active development. No game files included. ⭐ Star it if you like it! 💙 Donate: PayPal a.deghbouche@esi-sba.dz or ko-fi.com/abd_db
